description: CW-FIT is a class-wide classroom-management programme developed by its intervention research team for prekindergarten through grade 12 settings, combining behavioral skill lessons, team-based contingencies, praise, rewards, and targeted supports.
title: CW-FIT

description: A web-based Chinese essay-writing practice system developed for the study, providing guided writing questions, expert tips, reference links, revision tools, teacher feedback, and peer visibility for seventh-grade learners.
title: CWB online interactive writing system (May's Writing Meadow)

description: CWPT–LMS is computer-based software support for implementing, monitoring, and sustaining ClassWide Peer Tutoring, distributed by the Juniper Gardens Children's Project.
title: CWPT Learning Management System (CWPT–LMS)
